t.name: Carousel Product

ol.class: o_thumb_row position-static pt-2 pt-lg-0 mx-0 my-0 text-start

t.t-value: 'image_1920' if product_image.image_1920 else ('image_512' if product_image.image_512 else 'image_256')

img.t-att-srcset: '/web/image/%s/%s/%s/%sx%s 1x, /web/image/%s/%s/%s/%sx%s 2x' % (product_image._name, product_image.id, src_field, tw, th, product_image._name, product_image.id, src_field, tw2, th2)

i.class: fa fa-2x fa-play-circle o_product_video_thumb bg-black-50 text-center
